_comment: Supertrend bot — LIVE futures config. Launch with: supertrend_bot.exe supertrend.live.json  (the paper supertrend.json is unchanged, so you can run paper in parallel). SAME strategy/indicators as paper; only the account, port and sizing differ. JSON is read at startup — no rebuild needed to change these.
_GO_LIVE_CHECKLIST: 1) Replace REPLACE_WITH_LIVE_ACCOUNT below (both 'accounts' and 'default_account') with your real IBKR account (e.g. U1234567). 2) Confirm 'port' matches your LIVE gateway/TWS (IB Gateway live = 4001; TWS live = 7496). 3) Ensure the live account has FUTURES permission + a live CME/COMEX market-data subscription. 4) Confirm LPL compliance has cleared live futures trading on this account. 5) Start IB Gateway logged into the LIVE account, then launch. Strategy names are prefixed LIVE_ so logs/CSVs/state stay separate from paper.
_sizing_comment: fixed_stocks=2 is the SMALLEST size that keeps partial-profit working (trim 1 @ 2R, trail the other 1 @ 1R) — matches the backtest. fixed_stocks=1 would DISABLE partial profit (can't trim half of 1 lot; the single contract just rides the Supertrend trailing stop). max_position_notional is a hard safety cap.
_scaling_comment: To SCALE UP after live results are good: EITHER bump fixed_stocks (2 -> 4 -> 6...), OR switch to risk-based sizing per strategy: set fixed_stocks:0 and then size auto-computes as floor(strategy_capital * risk_per_trade_pct / risk-per-contract-at-stop), capped by max_position_notional. In risk-based mode, scale by raising strategy_capital and/or risk_per_trade_pct (partial profit needs the computed qty to reach >=2).
_contract_selection_comment: contract_selection: 'active' = IBKR ContFuture active/liquid front; 'quarterly' = Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec cycle (MGC synced to the index quarters); roll_buffer_days skips a contract within N days of expiry. expiry (optional) hard-pins a month 'YYYYMM'.
_stale_data_comment: stale_data_max_bars: if the newest completed bar is older than N*bar_seconds (3*5min=15min), SKIP all decisions, re-wake the HMDS farm and let the watchdog reconnect — prevents trading a stale backlog replayed one bar per poll after a reconnect. 0 disables. NEEDS REBUILD.
